---
title: "My Projects"
listing:
  contents: 
    - "projects/python/*/index.qmd"
    - "projects/r/*/index.qmd"
    - "projects/external.yml"
  type: grid
  fields: [image, date, title, reading-time, categories, description]
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  sort: "date desc"
---

```{=html}
<script>
// Only the external drill-project card leaves the site, so open it in a new tab.
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  const link = e.target.closest("a[href]");
  if (link && link.closest(".quarto-listing") && link.host !== window.location.host) {
    link.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
    link.setAttribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer");
  }
});
</script>
```
